messages:
maggie: Quick sync — pricing input needed: do we want a hard public price cap on hosted + addons to protect margin, or allow negotiated exceptions for Dedicated/Private? Need a decision for the roadmap doc by EOD.

Tom: I'd vote for a hard public cap on hosted. Negotiated carveouts for Dedicated only with approvals (sales + legal).

sara: +1 on public cap. Also we should define addon lifecycle: when we deprecate an addon, how long to grandfather customers? 90 days? 6 months?

devon: For strategic enterprise customers, 6 months. For small accounts, 90 days. Also need clarity on billing cutover and metering. ping @alan for legal impact.

alan: Legal perspective: 180 days is safest for enterprise contracts, but we can allow shorter windows if there's explicit contract language permitting immediate removal with notice. I'll draft a clause template.

maggie: OK — proposal from me: 1) public hard cap for Hosted API and public-facing add-ons (documented in pricing page); 2) Dedicated & Private can have negotiated caps but require approval flow; 3) addon sunset policy = 180d for enterprise, 90d otherwise.

Tom: For launch criteria we should require: cost model validated against 3 customer archetypes, perf SLOs hit on Dedicated pools, billing infra supports prorated adjustments, and legal clause available. Anything else?

sara: Add sales training + one-pager + product feature flags so we can hide/show addons per tenant.

devon: Also add telemetry: monitor usage skew, margin per customer, and abuse signals. We'll add a dashboard tile in Console.

maggie: Good. I'll draft the roadmap write-up today. Owners: tom -> pricing rules + public cap enforcement, sara -> addon lifecycle doc & sales one-pager, devon -> telemetry/dashboard, alan -> contract clause. @sales-bot please create sales enablement ticket.

sales-bot: ticket created: #4567 "Sales enablement: price cap & addon lifecycle" — assignees: tom, sara, devon. ETA 2025-02-14.

maggie: Thanks. If anyone objects to the 180/90 split speak now, otherwise I'll update the PR and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow.

Tom: no objections from me. :+1:

sara: fine here. :thumbsup:

alan: LGTM from legal side (will follow up with clause language).
